definitions.pinball: mean pinball loss over q10, q50, q90
definitions.coverage_80: share of actual prices inside [q10, q90]
definitions.skill_mae: 1 - MAE(model) / MAE(reference) on the same scored quarter-hours
definitions.price_spike: quarter-hours whose actual price is at or above the 90th percentile of all actual prices in the window
definitions.dm_test: Diebold-Mariano (HLN-corrected, two-sided) on daily MAE, negative statistic = first model better

definitions.hit_rate: share of days on which the recommended 3-hour window was the cheapest
definitions.near_rate: share of days on which it was at most 5 EUR/MWh (0.5 ct/kWh) more expensive than the cheapest window
definitions.mean_p_cheapest / mean_p_near: average stated probability; compare with the realised rate (calibration)
definitions.brier_*: mean squared difference between stated probability and outcome (0/1)
definitions.regret_eur_mwh: actual mean price in the recommended window minus the cheapest window
definitions.saving_vs_day_mean_eur_mwh: actual day mean minus actual mean price in the recommended window
